[package]
name = "jagent"
version = "0.7.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.86"
description = "Review-first terminal AI agent core: bounded sessions, provider protocols, streaming, and safety (sans-IO)"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/beamiter/jagent"
homepage = "https://github.com/beamiter/jagent"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/jagent"
keywords = ["terminal", "shell", "agent", "ai", "llm"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
include = ["/src/**", "/examples/**", "/docs/**", "/CHANGELOG.md", "/CONTRIBUTING.md", "/LICENSE-APACHE", "/LICENSE-MIT", "/README.md", "/SECURITY.md"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[dependencies]
regex = "1"
serde_json = "1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["arbitrary_precision", "raw_value"]

[package]
name = "jterm_core"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.86"
description = "Shared UI-independent core for the jterm family of terminal emulators"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/beamiter/jterm_core"
license = "MIT"
keywords = ["terminal", "pty", "parser", "jterm"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]

[dependencies]
crossbeam-channel = "0.5"
parking_lot = "0.12"
libc = "0.2.189"
log = "0.4"
lru = "0.18"
memchr = "2.8.3"
once_cell = "1.21"
dirs = "6.0"
fuzzy-matcher = "0.3"
serde_yaml_ng = "0.10"
toml = "1.1"
unicode-width = "0.2"

[dependencies.jagent]
git = "https://github.com/beamiter/jagent.git"
rev = "d1d3bc2251f3fba4468f689a655a932e00a83d86"

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.229"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.151"
features = ["raw_value"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/beamiter/jagent"]
git = "https://github.com/beamiter/jagent"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "d1d3bc2251f3fba4468f689a655a932e00a83d86"

[source."https://github.com/beamiter/jterm_core"]
git = "https://github.com/beamiter/jterm_core"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "eb4b5db17acb1591c87cd5489d595952b2f55c42"
